name: Husband As Leader
overview: Scripture teaches that a husband’s leadership in the family is modeled after Christ’s sacrificial love for the church, calling husbands to love their wives deeply and selflessly. This leadership is not domineering but marked by nurturing guidance, as fathers are instructed to raise children with the Lord’s instruction and care. Wives are called to respect their husbands, reflecting a God-ordained order that honors mutual love and reverence within the marriage relationship.
